dedupe_keys.name: data and code for beyond pue a field anchored public data cross checked framework for evaluating cooling efficiency and waste heat quality in liquid cooled data centers

description: The study author publishes de-identified anchor data and analysis code for evaluating liquid-cooled data-centre efficiency and waste-heat quality. Zenodo provides one archive; its metadata state CC BY 4.0 for data and the description states MIT for code. The package supports a four-by-four matrix, a reconstructed power component with a stated uncertainty band and the figures of the associated paper. These extracts can inform cooling-energy and heat-recovery assumptions in data-centre simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Coverage is the released de-identified extracts, not the underlying client certification reports, which the depositor says cannot be shared. A limitation is that source-site context, detailed instrumentation and external validity cannot be fully checked from an anonymised subset. The ZIP was not downloaded, so claims that every reported number can be reproduced were not tested.
